files.purpose: Presents an agent's structured questions (a QuestionRequest) as a chat badge at the end of the conversation whose popover holds a paged question sheet, one page per question, with choice rows, a free-text or secure field, page dots, and Skip/Next/Send buttons. It preselects choices whose label mentions 'recommended', pre-measures every page with NSHostingView so the frozen-size popover opens at its final height, and on Send or Skip closes the popover first and then hands the collected answers to ThreadRuntime.answer.

feature_notes: Preselection: for each question, choice labels containing "recommended" (localizedCaseInsensitiveContains) are preselected in order; a multiple-choice question gets all matches, a single-choice question only the first; questions with no match get no entry.

Page height: computed in init as `pageHeight = min(max(largest, 120), Self.maxHeight)` where largest is the tallest `NSHostingView(rootView: probe).fittingSize.height` over all questions, each probe a QuestionPage with `selections: .constant([:]), written: .constant([:])` framed to width 460; so a page's measured height ignores selection-driven weight changes; min 120, max 360. The doc comment at line 27 says "the largest page is measured once, here", but the code does not enforce once: pageHeight is a `private let`, not @State, so the measurement (one NSHostingView per question) re-runs on every QuestionSheet init, while selections/written/page keep their @State values across re-inits.
Single-choice pick (not multiple) on any page but the last calls advance(after: 0.18): the page moves on 0.18 s later. Picking on the last page does not auto-send.
onPick fires only when the tapped choice ends up selected (current.contains(choice.label)); deselecting does not advance.
Single choice toggles: tapping the selected choice clears the question's selection to []; multiple choice appends or removes the label.
Return in the text field calls advance(): on a non-last page it moves on; on the last page it sends only when unansweredCount is 0.
advance() on the last page recomputes answers and sends only if every question has at least one value; otherwise does nothing.

The delayed advance (single-choice pick on a non-last page, `advance(after: 0.18)`) checks `guard page < count - 1` only when called, then spawns an unstored Task that after 0.18 s runs `page += 1` from whatever page is current then, with no bounds re-check and no cancellation. So a dot tap or Previous within the 0.18 s is followed by +1 from the new page (a dot tap to the last page within 0.18 s pushes page to count, past the last page); Skip or Send within the 0.18 s closes the popover and answers, and the task still runs its `page += 1` afterwards on the dismissed sheet.

Answers: per question, the selected labels (full label text, including any ' (Recommended)' suffix) followed by the written text trimmed via String.trimmed, appended only when non-empty. Skip sends an empty dictionary [:].
A question counts as answered when its answer array is non-empty; isComplete means unanswered == 0.

bareLabel strips a trailing " (Recommended)" (case-insensitive compare of the last 14 characters) and marks it recommended; otherwise the label is kept whole and marked recommended if it contains "recommended" anywhere, so the pill can show beside an unstripped label.
Choices are keyed by index (id: \.offset) so identical labels both render, but selection is by label string, so two identical labels select together.
Send order: closePopover?() first so the popover animates away from the badge, then runtime.answer.

feature_notes: Load trigger: .task(id: loadKey) where loadKey combines diffRevision, diffSelection uuid or "all", and diffFocusRevision. If `!runtime.hasCachedDiff(selection: runtime.diffSelection)` it first runs `try? await Task.sleep(for: .milliseconds(180))` then `guard !Task.isCancelled else { return }`, per the comment so the empty popover appears cheaply before git, parse and view build. During that wait isLoading is still false, so an empty list shows "No changes yet", not the spinner.

load(): captures `let selection = runtime.diffSelection`; sets `changedTurns = runtime.turnsWithChanges()` BEFORE any await; `isLoading = true` with `defer { isLoading = false }`; `let parsed = await runtime.parsedDiff(selection: selection)`; `guard !Task.isCancelled else { return }` (line 129); `let focusEdits = runtime.diffFocusEdits` (line 135) captured and passed to `Task.detached(priority: .userInitiated) { focusedFiles(focusEdits, missingFrom: parsed) }.value`; a second `guard !Task.isCancelled else { return }` (line 137); then `files = missing.isEmpty ? parsed : missing + parsed` and `summary = FileChangeSummary(files: files)`. A load cancelled at either guard has already updated changedTurns (the turn menu) but leaves files, summary and collapsed untouched; the defer still clears isLoading.

Collapse rules after load: the focus set is re-read after the awaits as `let focus = Set(runtime.diffFocusEdits.map(\.path))` (line 143), separately from the focusEdits captured at line 135 for the patch parse, and it includes every edit path, also edits that focusedFiles skipped for an empty path or nil/empty diff (such an edit still focuses a parsed file its path matches). If any file matches focus (TouchedPaths.matches), `collapsed = Set(files.map(\.id)).subtracting(focused)`, scrollTarget = focused.first and scrollRequest += 1; else if files.count > 6 and collapsed is empty, every file but the first is collapsed; else collapsed is intersected with the current file ids (stale ids dropped). With 6 or fewer files and no focus, all start expanded.

focusedFiles skips edits with empty path or nil/empty diff, skips a path already covered by the parsed files or already added, parses with DiffParser.parseHunks(patch, path:) and keeps it only if it has hunks. makeSections: for each hunk with lines while budget remains, splits the budgeted prefix into runs of tinted (addition/deletion) vs untinted lines. If the first run is tinted and a tinted run is pending from the previous hunk, the runs continue the pending block with no header (header dropped inside a merged run); otherwise pending is flushed and a .header(hunk.header, hunkIndex) is appended only when showsLineNumbers is true. Tinted runs accumulate in pending; plain runs flush pending then append .plain. Flush splits pending into .tinted chunks of 40 lines, each carrying offset (chunk start) and count (whole block length) so corner rounding spans the whole block.
blockRounding(index:count:) gives radius 8 to top corners when index == 0 and bottom corners when index == count - 1.

DiffPopoverCoordinator doc: semitransient with a pass-through monitor; taps outside close it but still reach their target, so another turn's Review opens its diff in one tap; closes on Escape, the X button, Command-D, tapping the tab, or the thread going away.

sync(isVisible:runtime:): (1) a different runtime than the current one: close(), set the old runtime's isDiffVisible false if it was true, adopt the new runtime, seenOpenRequest = runtime.diffOpenRequest, and if the new runtime's isDiffVisible is true and WebsiteCaptures.isEnabled is false set it false; return without opening. (2) first adoption (runtime nil): adopt, record seenOpenRequest, and if isVisible and captures are off set isDiffVisible false and return. (3) otherwise set desiredVisible = isVisible and show() or close().
close(): stop monitors, desiredVisible false, session += 1, pendingSession = session, performClose(nil) if shown.

reopen(runtime:): for a different runtime falls back to sync(isVisible: runtime.isDiffVisible, runtime:); ignores it when diffOpenRequest equals seenOpenRequest; otherwise records it, sets desiredVisible, and if already shown on the same resolved anchor view does nothing, else stops monitors, bumps session and pendingSession, popover.close(), then show().

resolvedAnchor(): prefers runtime.diffAnchor view (if in a window) with runtime.diffAnchorEdge; else the first of the tab anchor or fallback (composer) view that is in a window, with edge .maxY; nil if none.

show(): requires runtime and an anchor; session += 1; returns if already shown; setFixedContent(DiffInspector(runtime:), size 640 x 540); starts monitors; records shownOn and shownRuntime; shows relative to the anchor view's bounds.

popoverDidClose: on the main actor stops monitors and clears desiredVisible; only when session == pendingSession (the close that posted it) clears shownRuntime.isDiffVisible and sets contentViewController = nil; always sets shownRuntime = nil.

Mouse monitor: a click whose window is the popover content's window passes through; any other left or right click calls close() and is still returned (delivered). Key monitor: keyCode 53 (Escape) closes and swallows the event (returns nil); other keys pass.
setAnchor and setFallbackAnchor call show() if desiredVisible.
